{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"QA orders found: {len(qa_orders)} rows")
print(f"QA orders status: {qa_orders['status'].unique()}")

# Check if any QA orders are marked as 'completed'
qa_completed = qa_orders[qa_orders['status'] == 'completed']
print(f"QA orders that are completed: {len(qa_completed)}")

# Filter out QA orders from the completed set
completed_orders = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['revenue'] != 999999.99)]
completed_actual_count = len(completed_orders)

completed_actual_count"}
